source: **route**: A route pattern to match against.{0}**rule**: A route rule configuration to apply to the matched route. {1} is a union of {2} and {3}, so a rule has to be valid for one Nitro major as a whole. A few rules differ between them: Nitro v3 takes {4} where v2 takes {5}, and v3 additionally accepts CORS options on {6} and {7} on {8}/{9} to reset an inherited rule.
